title: When He Touched My Mouth
old_p1: Jeremiah still felt small. He did not think he had one single good word tucked inside him.
Then a gentle touch came to Jeremiah's mouth. 'I have put my words in thy mouth,' Heavenly Father said, soft as morning.
Jeremiah did not have to make the words himself. They were given to him, like warm bread placed into open hands.
old_p2: Then Heavenly Father sent him out to build and to plant. It was like a gardener setting little trees into good ground.
When you do not know what to say, you can ask Heavenly Father. He is close to your mouth and your ear tonight. You will never have to find kind words all alone.
p1: Jeremiah still felt small. He did not think he had one good word inside him to say to the people.
Then Heavenly Father reached out and gently touched Jeremiah’s mouth. “I have put My words in your mouth,” He said.
Jeremiah did not have to make up the words by himself. Heavenly Father gave them to him, like warm bread put into open hands.
p2: Then Heavenly Father sent Jeremiah to the people to build up and to plant. That means his words would help good things grow, like a gardener planting little trees in good ground.
When you do not know what to say, you can ask Heavenly Father. He is close to you tonight. You never have to find kind words all alone.
